title: Game 9 & 10 — First Words (Find the Word + Build the Word)
description: Two word-learning games extending Game 8's literacy milestone: Find the Word (match a spoken/pictured word to 4 printed word cards) and Build the Word (spell pictured words by tapping letter tiles in order). 9-word uppercase pool reusing existing art; letter-texture composition; 2 new stickers; Hub becomes a 5x2 grid of 10 tiles.
